verses.original: וַיְדַבֵּ֥ר יְהוָ֖ה אֶל־ מֹשֶׁ֥ה לֵּאמֹֽר׃
verses.transliteration: way·ḏab·bêr Yah·weh ’el- mō·šeh lê·mōr
verses.literal: And the LORD said to Moses
verses.literalPt: Disse Jeová a Moisés:

verses.original: שְׁלַח־ לְךָ֣ אֲנָשִׁ֗ים וְיָתֻ֙רוּ֙ אֶת־ אֶ֣רֶץ כְּנַ֔עַן אֲשֶׁר־ אֲנִ֥י נֹתֵ֖ן לִבְנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל אִ֣ישׁ אֶחָד֩ אִ֨ישׁ אֶחָ֜ד לְמַטֵּ֤ה אֲבֹתָיו֙ תִּשְׁלָ֔חוּ כֹּ֖ל נָשִׂ֥יא בָהֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: šə·laḥ- lə·ḵā ’ă·nā·šîm wə·yā·ṯu·rū ’eṯ- ’e·reṣ kə·na·‘an ’ă·šer- ’ă·nî nō·ṯên liḇ·nê yiś·rā·’êl ’îš ’e·ḥāḏ ’îš ’e·ḥāḏ lə·maṭ·ṭêh ’ă·ḇō·ṯāw tiš·lā·ḥū kōl nā·śî ḇā·hem
verses.literal: Send out for yourself men to spy out the land of Canaan which I am giving to the Israelites . . . From each of their fathers’ tribes send one man . . . who is a leader among them
verses.literalPt: Envia homens que espiem a terra de Canaã, que eu hei de dar aos filhos de Israel; de cada tribo de seus pais enviarás um homem, sendo cada qual príncipe entre eles.

verses.original: וַיִּשְׁלַ֨ח אֹתָ֥ם מֹשֶׁ֛ה מִמִּדְבַּ֥ר פָּארָ֖ן עַל־ פִּ֣י יְהוָ֑ה כֻּלָּ֣ם אֲנָשִׁ֔ים רָאשֵׁ֥י בְנֵֽי־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל הֵֽמָּה׃
verses.transliteration: way·yiš·laḥ ’ō·ṯām mō·šeh mim·miḏ·bar pā·rān ‘al- pî Yah·weh kul·lām ’ă·nā·šîm rā·šê ḇə·nê- yiś·rā·’êl hêm·māh
verses.literal: So at the command of the LORD Moses sent them out from the Wilderness of Paran All the men were leaders of the Israelites
verses.literalPt: Do deserto de Parã enviou-os Moisés à ordem de Jeová, todos eles homens que eram cabeças dos filhos de Israel.

verses.original: וְאֵ֖לֶּה שְׁמוֹתָ֑ם לְמַטֵּ֣ה רְאוּבֵ֔ן שַׁמּ֖וּעַ בֶּן־ זַכּֽוּר׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’êl·leh šə·mō·w·ṯām lə·maṭ·ṭêh rə·’ū·ḇên šam·mū·a‘ ben- zak·kūr
verses.literal: and these were their names From the tribe of Reuben Shammua son of Zaccur
verses.literalPt: Estes eram os seus nomes: da tribo de Rúben, Samua, filho de Zacur.

verses.original: לְמַטֵּ֣ה שִׁמְע֔וֹן שָׁפָ֖ט בֶּן־ חוֹרִֽי׃
verses.transliteration: lə·maṭ·ṭêh šim·‘ō·wn šā·p̄āṭ ben- ḥō·w·rî
verses.literal: from the tribe of Simeon Shaphat son of Hori
verses.literalPt: Da tribo de Simeão, Safate, filho de Hori.

verses.original: לְמַטֵּ֣ה יְהוּדָ֔ה כָּלֵ֖ב בֶּן־ יְפֻנֶּֽה׃
verses.transliteration: lə·maṭ·ṭêh yə·hū·ḏāh kā·lêḇ ben- yə·p̄un·neh
verses.literal: from the tribe of Judah Caleb son of Jephunneh
verses.literalPt: Da tribo de Judá, Calebe, filho de Jefoné.

verses.original: לְמַטֵּ֣ה יִשָּׂשכָ֔ר יִגְאָ֖ל בֶּן־ יוֹסֵֽף׃
verses.transliteration: lə·maṭ·ṭêh yiś·śā·š·ḵār yiḡ·’āl ben- yō·w·sêp̄
verses.literal: from the tribe of Issachar Igal son of Joseph
verses.literalPt: Da tribo de Issacar, Jigeal, filho de José.

verses.original: לְמַטֵּ֥ה אֶפְרָ֖יִם הוֹשֵׁ֥עַ בִּן־ נֽוּן׃
verses.transliteration: lə·maṭ·ṭêh ’ep̄·rā·yim hō·wō·šê·a‘ bin- nūn
verses.literal: from the tribe of Ephraim Hoshea son of Nun
verses.literalPt: Da tribo de Efraim, Oseias, filho de Num.

verses.original: לְמַטֵּ֣ה בִנְיָמִ֔ן פַּלְטִ֖י בֶּן־ רָפֽוּא׃
verses.transliteration: lə·maṭ·ṭêh ḇin·yā·min pal·ṭî ben- rā·p̄ū
verses.literal: from the tribe of Benjamin Palti son of Raphu
verses.literalPt: Da tribo de Benjamim, Palti, filho de Rafu.

verses.original: לְמַטֵּ֣ה זְבוּלֻ֔ן גַּדִּיאֵ֖ל בֶּן־ סוֹדִֽי׃
verses.transliteration: lə·maṭ·ṭêh zə·ḇū·lun gad·dî·’êl ben- sō·w·ḏî
verses.literal: from the tribe of Zebulun Gaddiel son of Sodi
verses.literalPt: Da tribo de Zebulom, Gadiel, filho de Sodi.

verses.original: לְמַטֵּ֥ה יוֹסֵ֖ף לְמַטֵּ֣ה מְנַשֶּׁ֑ה גַּדִּ֖י בֶּן־ סוּסִֽי׃
verses.transliteration: lə·maṭ·ṭêh yō·w·sêp̄ lə·maṭ·ṭêh mə·naš·šeh gad·dî ben- sū·sî
verses.literal: from the tribe of Manasseh a tribe of Joseph Gaddi son of Susi
verses.literalPt: Da tribo de José, a saber, da tribo de Manassés, Gadi, filho de Susi.

verses.original: לְמַטֵּ֣ה דָ֔ן עַמִּיאֵ֖ל בֶּן־ גְּמַלִּֽי׃
verses.transliteration: lə·maṭ·ṭêh ḏān ‘am·mî·’êl ben- gə·mal·lî
verses.literal: from the tribe of Dan Ammiel son of Gemalli
verses.literalPt: Da tribo de Dã, Amiel, filho de Gemali.

verses.original: לְמַטֵּ֣ה אָשֵׁ֔ר סְת֖וּר בֶּן־ מִיכָאֵֽל׃
verses.transliteration: lə·maṭ·ṭêh ’ā·šêr sə·ṯūr ben- mî·ḵā·’êl
verses.literal: from the tribe of Asher Sethur son of Michael
verses.literalPt: Da tribo de Aser, Setur, filho de Micael.

verses.original: לְמַטֵּ֣ה נַפְתָּלִ֔י נַחְבִּ֖י בֶּן־ וָפְסִֽי׃
verses.transliteration: lə·maṭ·ṭêh nap̄·tā·lî naḥ·bî ben- wā·p̄ə·sî
verses.literal: from the tribe of Naphtali Nahbi son of Vophsi
verses.literalPt: Da tribo de Naftali, Nabi, filho de Vofsi.

verses.original: לְמַטֵּ֣ה גָ֔ד גְּאוּאֵ֖ל בֶּן־ מָכִֽי׃
verses.transliteration: lə·maṭ·ṭêh ḡāḏ gə·’ū·’êl ben- mā·ḵî
verses.literal: and from the tribe of Gad Geuel son of Machi
verses.literalPt: Da tribo de Gade, Geuel, filho de Maqui.

verses.original: אֵ֚לֶּה שְׁמ֣וֹת הָֽאֲנָשִׁ֔ים אֲשֶׁר־ שָׁלַ֥ח מֹשֶׁ֖ה לָת֣וּר אֶת־ הָאָ֑רֶץ וַיִּקְרָ֥א מֹשֶׁ֛ה לְהוֹשֵׁ֥עַ בִּן־ נ֖וּן יְהוֹשֻֽׁעַ׃
verses.transliteration: ’êl·leh šə·mō·wṯ hā·’ă·nā·šîm ’ă·šer- šā·laḥ mō·šeh lā·ṯūr ’eṯ- hā·’ā·reṣ way·yiq·rā mō·šeh lə·hō·wō·šê·a‘ bin- nūn yə·hō·wō·šu·a‘
verses.literal: These were the names of the men Moses sent to spy out the land and Moses gave to Hoshea son of Nun the name Joshua
verses.literalPt: Estes são os nomes dos homens que Moisés enviou a espiar a terra. A Oseias, filho de Num, Moisés chamou Josué.

verses.original: וַיִּשְׁלַ֤ח אֹתָם֙ מֹשֶׁ֔ה לָת֖וּר אֶת־ אֶ֣רֶץ כְּנָ֑עַן וַיֹּ֣אמֶר אֲלֵהֶ֗ם עֲל֥וּ זֶה֙ בַּנֶּ֔גֶב וַעֲלִיתֶ֖ם אֶת־ הָהָֽר׃
verses.transliteration: way·yiš·laḥ ’ō·ṯām mō·šeh lā·ṯūr ’eṯ- ’e·reṣ kə·nā·‘an way·yō·mer ’ă·lê·hem ‘ă·lū zeh ban·ne·ḡeḇ wa·‘ă·lî·ṯem ’eṯ- hā·hār
verses.literal: When Moses sent them to spy out the land of Canaan he told them Go up through the Negev and into the hill country
verses.literalPt: Moisés enviou-os a espiar a terra de Canaã e disse-lhes: Subi ao Neguebe e penetrai nas montanhas.

verses.original: וּרְאִיתֶ֥ם אֶת־ הָאָ֖רֶץ מַה־ הִ֑וא וְאֶת־ הָעָם֙ הַיֹּשֵׁ֣ב עָלֶ֔יהָ הֶחָזָ֥ק הוּא֙ הֲרָפֶ֔ה הַמְעַ֥ט ה֖וּא אִם־ רָֽב׃
verses.transliteration: ū·rə·’î·ṯem ’eṯ- hā·’ā·reṣ mah- hî wə·’eṯ- hā·‘ām hay·yō·šêḇ ‘ā·le·hā he·ḥā·zāq hū hă·rā·p̄eh ham·‘aṭ hū ’im- rāḇ
verses.literal: See what the land is like and whether its people are strong . . . or weak few . . . or many
verses.literalPt: Vede a terra, que tal é; e o povo que nela habita, se é forte ou fraco, se são poucos ou muitos;

verses.original: וּמָ֣ה הָאָ֗רֶץ אֲשֶׁר־ הוּא֙ יֹשֵׁ֣ב בָּ֔הּ הֲטוֹבָ֥ה הִ֖וא אִם־ רָעָ֑ה וּמָ֣ה הֶֽעָרִ֗ים אֲשֶׁר־ הוּא֙ יוֹשֵׁ֣ב בָּהֵ֔נָּה הַבְּמַֽחֲנִ֖ים אִ֥ם בְּמִבְצָרִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: ū·māh hā·’ā·reṣ ’ă·šer- hū yō·šêḇ bāh hă·ṭō·w·ḇāh hî ’im- rā·‘āh ū·māh he·‘ā·rîm ’ă·šer- hū yō·wō·šêḇ bā·hên·nāh hab·bə·ma·ḥă·nîm ’im bə·miḇ·ṣā·rîm
verses.literal: Is the land where they live good or bad . . . Are the cities where they dwell . . . open camps or fortifications
verses.literalPt: que tal é a terra em que habitam, se é boa ou má; que tais são as cidades em que habitam, se em arraiais ou em fortalezas;

verses.original: וּמָ֣ה הָ֠אָרֶץ הַשְּׁמֵנָ֨ה הִ֜וא אִם־ רָזָ֗ה הֲיֵֽשׁ־ בָּ֥הּ עֵץ֙ אִם־ אַ֔יִן וְהִ֨תְחַזַּקְתֶּ֔ם וּלְקַחְתֶּ֖ם מִפְּרִ֣י הָאָ֑רֶץ וְהַ֨יָּמִ֔ים יְמֵ֖י בִּכּוּרֵ֥י עֲנָבִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: ū·māh hā·’ā·reṣ haš·šə·mê·nāh hî ’im- rā·zāh hă·yêš- bāh ‘êṣ ’im- ’a·yin wə·hiṯ·ḥaz·zaq·tem ū·lə·qaḥ·tem mip·pə·rî hā·’ā·reṣ wə·hay·yā·mîm yə·mê bik·kū·rê ‘ă·nā·ḇîm
verses.literal: Is the soil fertile . . . or unproductive Are there trees in it or not Be courageous and bring back some of the fruit of the land It was the season . . . for the first ripe grapes
verses.literalPt: e que tal é a terra, se gorda ou magra, se há nela lenha ou não. Esforçai-vos por obter do fruto da terra. Ora, a estação era a das uvas temporãs.

verses.original: וַֽיַּעֲל֖וּ וַיָּתֻ֣רוּ אֶת־ הָאָ֑רֶץ מִמִּדְבַּר־ צִ֥ן עַד־ רְחֹ֖ב לְבֹ֥א חֲמָֽת׃
verses.transliteration: way·ya·‘ă·lū way·yā·ṯu·rū ’eṯ- hā·’ā·reṣ mim·miḏ·bar- ṣin ‘aḏ- rə·ḥōḇ lə·ḇō ḥă·māṯ
verses.literal: So they went up and spied out the land from the Wilderness of Zin as far as Rehob toward Lebo-hamath
verses.literalPt: Assim, subiram e espiaram a terra desde o deserto de Zim até Reobe, até a entrada de Hamate.

verses.original: וַיַּעֲל֣וּ בַנֶּגֶב֮ וַיָּבֹ֣א עַד־ חֶבְרוֹן֒ וְשָׁ֤ם אֲחִימַן֙ שֵׁשַׁ֣י וְתַלְמַ֔י יְלִידֵ֖י הָעֲנָ֑ק וְחֶבְר֗וֹן שֶׁ֤בַע שָׁנִים֙ נִבְנְתָ֔ה לִפְנֵ֖י צֹ֥עַן מִצְרָֽיִם׃
verses.transliteration: way·ya·‘ă·lū ḇan·ne·ḡeḇ way·yā·ḇō ‘aḏ- ḥeḇ·rō·wn wə·šām ’ă·ḥî·man šê·šay wə·ṯal·may yə·lî·ḏê hā·‘ă·nāq wə·ḥeḇ·rō·wn še·ḇa‘ šā·nîm niḇ·nə·ṯāh lip̄·nê ṣō·‘an miṣ·rā·yim
verses.literal: They went up through the Negev and came to Hebron where Ahiman Sheshai and Talmai the descendants of Anak dwelled It had been built seven years before Zoan in Egypt
verses.literalPt: Subiram ao Neguebe e foram a Hebrom, onde estavam Aimã, Sesai e Talmai, filhos de Anaque (Ora, Hebrom foi edificada sete anos antes de Zoã, no Egito).

verses.original: וַיָּבֹ֜אוּ עַד־ נַ֣חַל אֶשְׁכֹּ֗ל וַיִּכְרְת֨וּ מִשָּׁ֤ם זְמוֹרָה֙ וְאֶשְׁכּ֤וֹל עֲנָבִים֙ אֶחָ֔ד וַיִּשָּׂאֻ֥הוּ בַמּ֖וֹט בִּשְׁנָ֑יִם וּמִן־ הָרִמֹּנִ֖ים וּמִן־ הַתְּאֵנִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: way·yā·ḇō·’ū ‘aḏ- na·ḥal ’eš·kōl way·yiḵ·rə·ṯū miš·šām zə·mō·w·rāh wə·’eš·kō·wl ‘ă·nā·ḇîm ’e·ḥāḏ way·yiś·śā·’u·hū ḇam·mō·wṭ biš·nā·yim ū·min- hā·rim·mō·nîm ū·min- hat·tə·’ê·nîm
verses.literal: When they came to the Valley of Eshcol they cut down . . . a branch with a single cluster of grapes which they carried on a pole between two men They also took some pomegranates . . . and figs
verses.literalPt: Foram até o vale de Escol e ali cortaram um ramo de vide com um só cacho, o qual dois homens levaram sobre uma padiola; levaram também romãs e figos.

verses.original: לַמָּק֣וֹם הַה֔וּא קָרָ֖א נַ֣חַל אֶשְׁכּ֑וֹל עַ֚ל אֹד֣וֹת הָֽאֶשְׁכּ֔וֹל אֲשֶׁר־ כָּרְת֥וּ מִשָּׁ֖ם בְּנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
verses.transliteration: lam·mā·qō·wm ha·hū qā·rā na·ḥal ’eš·kō·wl ‘al ’ō·ḏō·wṯ hā·’eš·kō·wl ’ă·šer- kā·rə·ṯū miš·šām bə·nê yiś·rā·’êl
verses.literal: Because of . . . the cluster of grapes the Israelites . . . cut there that place was called the Valley of Eshcol
verses.literalPt: Esse lugar se chamou o vale de Escol, por causa do cacho que ali cortaram os filhos de Israel.

verses.original: וַיָּשֻׁ֖בוּ מִתּ֣וּר הָאָ֑רֶץ מִקֵּ֖ץ אַרְבָּעִ֥ים יֽוֹם׃
verses.transliteration: way·yā·šu·ḇū mit·tūr hā·’ā·reṣ miq·qêṣ ’ar·bā·‘îm yō·wm
verses.literal: After forty days the men returned from spying out the land
verses.literalPt: Passados quarenta dias, voltaram de espiarem a terra.

verses.original: וַיֵּלְכ֡וּ וַיָּבֹאוּ֩ אֶל־ מֹשֶׁ֨ה וְאֶֽל־ אַהֲרֹ֜ן וְאֶל־ כָּל־ עֲדַ֧ת בְּנֵֽי־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֛ל אֶל־ מִדְבַּ֥ר פָּארָ֖ן קָדֵ֑שָׁה וַיָּשִׁ֨יבוּ אוֹתָ֤ם דָּבָר֙ וְאֶת־ כָּל־ הָ֣עֵדָ֔ה וַיַּרְא֖וּם אֶת־ פְּרִ֥י הָאָֽרֶץ׃
verses.transliteration: way·yê·lə·ḵū way·yā·ḇō·’ū ’el- mō·šeh wə·’el- ’a·hă·rōn wə·’el- kāl- ‘ă·ḏaṯ bə·nê- yiś·rā·’êl ’el- miḏ·bar pā·rān qā·ḏê·šāh way·yā·šî·ḇū ’ō·w·ṯām dā·ḇār wə·’eṯ- kāl- hā·‘ê·ḏāh way·yar·’ūm ’eṯ- pə·rî hā·’ā·reṣ
verses.literal: and they went back . . . to Moses Aaron . . . and the whole congregation . . . of Israel in the Wilderness of Paran at Kadesh They brought back a report for the whole congregation and showed them the fruit of the land
verses.literalPt: Caminharam e vieram ter com Moisés, e com Arão, e com toda a congregação dos filhos de Israel, ao deserto de Parã, a Cades; deram-lhes notícias, a eles e a toda a congregação, e mostraram-lhes o fruto da terra.

verses.original: וַיְסַפְּרוּ־ לוֹ֙ וַיֹּ֣אמְר֔וּ בָּ֕אנוּ אֶל־ הָאָ֖רֶץ אֲשֶׁ֣ר שְׁלַחְתָּ֑נוּ וְ֠גַם זָבַ֨ת חָלָ֥ב וּדְבַ֛שׁ הִ֖וא וְזֶה־ פִּרְיָֽהּ׃
verses.transliteration: way·sap·pə·rū- lōw way·yō·mə·rū bā·nū ’el- hā·’ā·reṣ ’ă·šer šə·laḥ·tā·nū wə·ḡam zā·ḇaṯ ḥā·lāḇ ū·ḏə·ḇaš hî wə·zeh- pir·yāh
verses.literal: And they gave this account to Moses . . . We went into the land to which you sent us and indeed it is flowing with milk and honey Here is some of its fruit
verses.literalPt: Deram-lhe conta, e disseram: Fomos à terra a que nos enviaste, a qual, na verdade, mana leite e mel; este é o fruto da terra.

verses.original: אֶ֚פֶס כִּֽי־ עַ֣ז הָעָ֔ם הַיֹּשֵׁ֖ב בָּאָ֑רֶץ וְהֶֽעָרִ֗ים בְּצֻר֤וֹת גְּדֹלֹת֙ מְאֹ֔ד וְגַם־ יְלִדֵ֥י הָֽעֲנָ֖ק רָאִ֥ינוּ שָֽׁם׃
verses.transliteration: ’e·p̄es kî- ‘az hā·‘ām hay·yō·šêḇ bā·’ā·reṣ wə·he·‘ā·rîm bə·ṣu·rō·wṯ gə·ḏō·lōṯ mə·’ōḏ wə·ḡam- yə·li·ḏê hā·‘ă·nāq rā·’î·nū šām
verses.literal: Nevertheless . . . the people living in the land are strong and the cities . . . are large and fortified We even saw the descendants of Anak there
verses.literalPt: Todavia, o povo que habita nessa terra é forte, e as cidades são fortificadas e mui grandes; também vimos ali os filhos de Anaque.

verses.original: עֲמָלֵ֥ק יוֹשֵׁ֖ב בְּאֶ֣רֶץ הַנֶּ֑גֶב וְ֠הַֽחִתִּי וְהַיְבוּסִ֤י וְהָֽאֱמֹרִי֙ יוֹשֵׁ֣ב בָּהָ֔ר וְהַֽכְּנַעֲנִי֙ יֹשֵׁ֣ב עַל־ הַיָּ֔ם וְעַ֖ל יַ֥ד הַיַּרְדֵּֽן׃
verses.transliteration: ‘ă·mā·lêq yō·wō·šêḇ bə·’e·reṣ han·ne·ḡeḇ wə·ha·ḥit·tî wə·hay·ḇū·sî wə·hā·’ĕ·mō·rî yō·wō·šêḇ bā·hār wə·hak·kə·na·‘ă·nî yō·šêḇ ‘al- hay·yām wə·‘al yaḏ hay·yar·dên
verses.literal: The Amalekites live in the land of the Negev the Hittites Jebusites and Amorites live in the hill country and the Canaanites live by the sea and along . . . the Jordan
verses.literalPt: Amaleque habita na terra do Neguebe, os heteus, os jebuseus e os amorreus habitam nas montanhas, e os cananeus habitam junto do mar, à margem do Jordão.

verses.original: וַיַּ֧הַס כָּלֵ֛ב אֶת־ הָעָ֖ם אֶל־ מֹשֶׁ֑ה וַיֹּ֗אמֶר עָלֹ֤ה נַעֲלֶה֙ וְיָרַ֣שְׁנוּ אֹתָ֔הּ כִּֽי־ יָכ֥וֹל נוּכַ֖ל לָֽהּ׃
verses.transliteration: way·ya·has kā·lêḇ ’eṯ- hā·‘ām ’el- mō·šeh way·yō·mer ‘ā·lōh na·‘ă·leh wə·yā·raš·nū ’ō·ṯāh kî- yā·ḵō·wl nū·ḵal lāh
verses.literal: Then Caleb quieted the people before Moses and said We must go up . . . and take possession of the land for we can certainly conquer . . . it
verses.literalPt: Então, Calebe fez calar o povo diante de Moisés e disse: Subamos e possuamos a terra, porque bem podemos prevalecer contra ela.

verses.original: וְהָ֨אֲנָשִׁ֜ים אֲשֶׁר־ עָל֤וּ עִמּוֹ֙ אָֽמְר֔וּ לֹ֥א נוּכַ֖ל לַעֲל֣וֹת אֶל־ הָעָ֑ם כִּֽי־ חָזָ֥ק ה֖וּא מִמֶּֽנּוּ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hā·’ă·nā·šîm ’ă·šer- ‘ā·lū ‘im·mōw ’ā·mə·rū lō nū·ḵal la·‘ă·lō·wṯ ’el- hā·‘ām kî- ḥā·zāq hū mim·men·nū
verses.literal: But the men who had gone up with him replied We cannot . . . go up against the people for they are stronger than we are
verses.literalPt: Porém os homens que subiram com ele disseram: Não poderemos subir contra o povo, porque é mais forte do que nós.

verses.original: וַיּוֹצִ֜יאוּ דִּבַּ֤ת הָאָ֙רֶץ֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר תָּר֣וּ אֹתָ֔הּ אֶל־ בְּנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל לֵאמֹ֑ר הָאָ֡רֶץ אֲשֶׁר֩ עָבַ֨רְנוּ בָ֜הּ לָת֣וּר אֹתָ֗הּ אֶ֣רֶץ אֹכֶ֤לֶת יוֹשְׁבֶ֙יהָ֙ הִ֔וא וְכָל־ הָעָ֛ם אֲשֶׁר־ רָאִ֥ינוּ בְתוֹכָ֖הּ אַנְשֵׁ֥י מִדּֽוֹת׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·w·ṣî·’ū dib·baṯ hā·’ā·reṣ ’ă·šer tā·rū ’ō·ṯāh ’el- bə·nê yiś·rā·’êl lê·mōr hā·’ā·reṣ ’ă·šer ‘ā·ḇar·nū ḇāh lā·ṯūr ’ō·ṯāh ’e·reṣ ’ō·ḵe·leṯ yō·wō·šə·ḇe·hā hî wə·ḵāl hā·‘ām ’ă·šer- rā·’î·nū ḇə·ṯō·w·ḵāh ’an·šê mid·dō·wṯ
verses.literal: So they gave the Israelites a bad report . . . . . . about the land that they had spied out The land we explored . . . . . . - devours its inhabitants . . . and all the people we saw there are great in stature
verses.literalPt: Diante dos filhos de Israel, infamaram a terra que haviam espiado, dizendo: A terra por meio da qual passamos para a espiar é terra que devora os seus habitantes; todo o povo que vimos nela são homens de grande estatura.

verses.original: וְשָׁ֣ם רָאִ֗ינוּ אֶת־ הַנְּפִילִ֛ים בְּנֵ֥י עֲנָ֖ק מִן־ הַנְּפִלִ֑ים וַנְּהִ֤י בְעֵינֵ֙ינוּ֙ כַּֽחֲגָבִ֔ים וְכֵ֥ן הָיִ֖ינוּ בְּעֵינֵיהֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: wə·šām rā·’î·nū ’eṯ- han·nə·p̄î·lîm bə·nê ‘ă·nāq min- han·nə·p̄i·lîm wan·nə·hî ḇə·‘ê·nê·nū ka·ḥă·ḡā·ḇîm wə·ḵên hā·yî·nū bə·‘ê·nê·hem
verses.literal: We even saw the Nephilim there the descendants of Anak that come from the Nephilim We seemed like grasshoppers in our own sight and we must have seemed . . . the same to them
verses.literalPt: Ali, vimos os nefilins (os filhos de Anaque são dos nefilins); éramos, aos nossos próprios olhos, como gafanhotos, e assim também o éramos aos seus olhos.
